name: Pending Feedback Report
query:
SELECT
    i.name AS "Interview:Link/Interview:160",
    ja.applicant_name AS "Ứng viên:Data:180",
    u.full_name AS "Người phỏng vấn:Data:180",
    i.start_time AS "Thời gian phỏng vấn:Datetime:160",
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, i.end_time, NOW()), 0) AS "Thời gian quá hạn:Duration:150"
FROM `tabInterview` i
INNER JOIN `tabInterviewer Assignment` ia
    ON ia.parent = i.name
    AND ia.parenttype = 'Interview'
    AND ia.parentfield = 'interviewers'
INNER JOIN `tabJob Applicant` ja
    ON ja.name = i.job_applicant
INNER JOIN `tabUser` u
    ON u.name = ia.interviewer
WHERE i.status = 'In Progress'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM `tabInterview Feedback` f
        WHERE f.interview_ = i.name
            AND f.interviewer = ia.interviewer
            AND f.is_submitted = 1
    )
ORDER BY i.end_time ASC, i.name, u.full_name
